setup: Fresh user in Europe/Berlin, no deployed routines, Gmail connector enabled, owns github.com/example/webapp. Vague intent: just wants to try the thing.
expected_behavior: Detects bootstrap mode, enters the express path, and asks ONLY the four questions from references/defaults.md (watched repos, ops repo, email+timezone, forbidden areas) — no interview beyond them
Presents the starter composition (digest + watchdog) for a yes/no instead of an open design discussion

Adapts examples/starter-fleet/ rather than authoring from blank templates: replaces placeholders, sets timezone Europe/Berlin, recomputes BOTH cron_utc values from the default local times (digest 11:50pm, watchdog 8:00am), and updates both cadence_local fields to match
Runs scripts/validate_fleet.py on the adapted manifest and resolves any finding before committing — the express path must not skip B4's validation
Commits and pushes the ops repo before deploying, deploys digest then watchdog, writes trigger_ids back, and re-pushes
Hand-off states the runs/month estimate and that reconcile runs can change any defaulted choice later
